title: A Uniform for the Compass
author: Gideon Vasquez
blurb: Jude Ashgrove, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
